'''Rel Rogock''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Seek out Rel Rogock and Teemu Komo, the Controller and Grand Foreman, in the Imperial Mine and eliminate them so that these attacks may cease|Grenz Zittoun, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:OoMM" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Rel Rogock worked in a [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|mining facility]] operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During that time, he served as the grand foreman.<ref name="SWG:OoMM" />

[[File:Imperial_Mine_Lok.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial Mine]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the miners hit a gas pocket, releasing toxic vapors in the mine. The gas did not physically injured the miners but made them crazy and very aggressive.<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Jinkins|Lok}}</ref> Rel Rogock and the mine controller [[Teemu Komo]] then commanded the miners in random attacks against inhabitants of Lok.<ref name="SWG:OoMM" /> The situation in the mine was later discovered by [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], the powerful criminal organization on Lok. [[Jinkins]], Nym's chief engineer, thus decided to obtain a sample of the gas in order to study it and use it as a weapon if possible.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> Jinkins thus tasked a group of adventurous [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] of the Lok Revenants with retrieving a sample of toxic gas.<ref name="SWG:RtMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Mine Filter|Lok}}</ref> While Jinkins was preparing the assault, [[Grenz Zittoun]], another lieutenant of Nym, realized that the raid on the mine could be an opportunity to get rid of the mine controller and the grand foreman.<ref name="SWG:OoMM" /> The Lok Revenants then raided the Imperial mine and retrieved a sealed container of the poisonous gas for Jinkins.<ref name="SWG:RtMF" /> During the assault, the spacers attacked and killed both Rel Rogock and Teemu Komo, thereby stopping the attacks on the people of Lok.<ref name="SWG:OoMM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rel Rogock was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OoMM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rel Rogock was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:OoMM" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>

During the conversation that started the quest "[[W:c:swg:Out of My Mine|Out of My Mine]]," Grenz Zittoun incorectly stated that the Grand Foreman of the Imperial Mine was [[Ran Machado]].<ref name="SWG:OoMM" /> Machado was in fact a member of the Lok Revenants.<ref name="SWG:WWFR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Weed Whacker Foliage Requisition|Lok}}</ref>
